stop_rule: Finish one executable optional repair, its positive strict replay and two old-accept/new-reject controls. Leave frozen files and selected default adoption unchanged.
evidence: Gate replay checks 69,120 complete owner records and 15 semantic/malformed controls; explicit full_check separately runs all 11 unchanged strict stages and the two PR2301 six-stage accepted counterexamples.
